👁️ Eye Pattern: Reptilian Pupils
Narrow, vertical pupils with angular iris shapes — a cold, scaled-creature aesthetic in the eyes.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Reptilian Pupils.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Both eyes have narrow vertical slit pupils like a reptile's, contracted sharply within the colored irises. Apply reptilian vertical slit pupils to both eyes using selected eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
